description: A function defined under a condition is visible only through its module fallback.

expected_affected.tests/test_price.py::test_price: The literal true branch defines price, whose returned value changes.

expected_unaffected.tests/test_control.py::test_control: Calls only unchanged control.healthy in an independent subsystem.
expected_unaffected.tests/test_health.py::test_health: Only calls the unchanged healthy function; the conditional function has no side effects.

false_positives.tests/test_health.py::test_health: Both imports reach the changed module despite healthy being independent.

limitations: Definitions under conditionals are not individually indexed. Module fallback rescues the affected test but overselects the sibling test.
